note: Compliance-support reference for prototype jurisdiction gating, not legal advice and not a substitute for current legal research. State and local rules change; a licensed broker or counsel should own production review.

sources.label: HUD 2021 Fair Housing Act LGBTQ enforcement announcement

source of income.description: Housing vouchers and other lawful income sources are not named protected classes under the federal Fair Housing Act; coverage is state/local dependent.

state_notes.TX: Texas is listed as preempting local source-of-income protections; voucher refusal is logged for visibility but not treated as a state-law publishing block in this prototype.
state_notes.NY: New York source-of-income protection is volatile in 2026; the NYC local Human Rights Law remains independently enforced, and the seeded NY property is modeled as NYC-local protected.

sexual orientation.description: The Fair Housing Act text does not name sexual orientation; explicit housing protections remain state/local dependent while federal enforcement posture has shifted.

state_notes.TX: Texas has no statewide sexual-orientation housing protection in this prototype reference; local ordinances may still matter.

gender identity.description: The Fair Housing Act text does not name gender identity; explicit housing protections remain state/local dependent while federal enforcement posture has shifted.

marital status.description: The Fair Housing Act text does not name marital status; explicit housing protections are state/local dependent, though marital status is one of the more commonly state-protected classes nationally.

state_notes.TX: Texas has no statewide marital-status housing protection in this prototype reference; local ordinances may still matter.

age.description: Age-based exclusion of applicants (distinct from the HOPA senior-housing exemption, which permits age-restricted marketing only on verified qualifying properties) is state/local dependent and less uniformly protected than other classes.

state_notes.TX: Texas has no statewide age housing protection in this prototype reference; local ordinances may still matter.

military / veteran status.description: Military and veteran status is not a federal Fair Housing Act class; explicit protections are state/local dependent.

state_notes.TX: Texas has no statewide military/veteran-status housing protection in this prototype reference; local ordinances may still matter.

source of income.note: New York City is modeled as locally protected for source of income, independent of the unsettled 2026 state-law posture.
